user_query: I'm planning a romantic dinner and I want to create a playlist of love songs. Can you fetch a playlist from Spotify and provide me with the details? I would also like to retrieve the lyrics for these songs from the SongMeanings API.

TaskList.description: Fetch a romantic love songs playlist from Spotify.
Retrieve the details of the fetched playlist, including song titles and artists.
Fetch the lyrics for each song retrieved in the previous step using the SongMeanings API.
